<script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/1.10.2/jquery.min.js"></script>
<script type="text/javascript">
	$('#password1').on('input', function(){
		if($('#password1').val().length > 50){
			alert('Password can only be 50 characters long.');
			var newPassword = $('#password1').val().substring(0,50);
			$('#password1').val(newPassword);
		}
	});
	function showhideStates(name){
		alert('test');
	}
	function changeSubMenu(type){
		if(type == 'jobseeker'){
			document.getElementById('menubar_jobseeker').style.display = '';
			document.getElementById('menubar_resources').style.display = 'none';
			document.getElementById('menubar_careerplanning').style.display = 'none';
		}
		else if(type == 'resources'){
			document.getElementById('menubar_jobseeker').style.display = 'none';
			document.getElementById('menubar_resources').style.display = '';
			document.getElementById('menubar_careerplanning').style.display = 'none';
		}
		else if(type == 'career'){
			document.getElementById('menubar_jobseeker').style.display = 'none';
			document.getElementById('menubar_resources').style.display = 'none';
			document.getElementById('menubar_careerplanning').style.display = '';
		}
	}
	function getLocation(position) {
     	var latitude = position.coords.latitude;
     	var longitude = position.coords.longitude;

     	$.getJSON('https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json',
			{
				latlng: latitude+','+longitude,
				key: 'AIzaSyD0vdW49IZozj7vTarP_oOnWSoFW6fw4t8'
			},
			function(locationInfo){
				if(locationInfo.results[0] !== 'undefined'){
					var locationString = '<strong>Location:</strong> ';
					
					var city='';
					var state='';
					var zip='';
					var objLength = locationInfo.results[0].address_components.length;
					for(i=0;i<objLength;i++){
						if(locationInfo.results[0].address_components[i].types=="locality,political"){
							city = locationInfo.results[0].address_components[i].long_name;
						}
						else if(locationInfo.results[0].address_components[i].types=="administrative_area_level_1,political"){
							state = locationInfo.results[0].address_components[i].short_name;
						}
						else if(locationInfo.results[0].address_components[i].types=="postal_code"){
							zip = locationInfo.results[0].address_components[i].long_name;
						}
					}
					locationString = locationString + city + ' ' + state + ', ' + zip;
					locationString = locationString + ' ' + '<a href="" onclick="$(\'#homepage_location_box\').toggle(\'fast\');return false;">Change</a>';
					document.getElementById('homepage_location_container').innerHTML = locationString;
					$.get("/newtcore/candidates/ajax_getstate.cfm",{statename: state},
			      	function(stateinfo){
			      		$.get("/newtcore/candidates/ajax_setstatesession.cfm",{stateid:stateinfo});
			      		setJobs(stateinfo);
			      	}
			      );
				}
			}
		);
	}
	function getLocationZip(zip){
		if(zip.length >= 5 && zip.length <= 7){
			$.getJSON('https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json',
				{
					address: zip,
					key: 'AIzaSyD0vdW49IZozj7vTarP_oOnWSoFW6fw4t8'
				},
				function(locationInfo){
					if(locationInfo.results[0] !== 'undefined'){
						var city='';
						var state='';
						var zip='';
						var objLength = locationInfo.results[0].address_components.length;
						for(i=0;i<objLength;i++){
							if(locationInfo.results[0].address_components[i].types[0]=="locality"){
								city = locationInfo.results[0].address_components[i].long_name;
							}
							else if(locationInfo.results[0].address_components[i].types[0]=="administrative_area_level_1"){
								state = locationInfo.results[0].address_components[i].short_name;
							}
							else if(locationInfo.results[0].address_components[i].types[0]=="postal_code"){
								zip = locationInfo.results[0].address_components[i].long_name;
							}
						}
						var locationString = '<strong>Location:</strong> ';
						locationString = locationString + city + ' ' + state + ', ' + zip;
						locationString = locationString + ' ' + '<a href="" onclick="$(\'#homepage_location_box\').toggle(\'fast\');return false;">Change</a>';

						document.getElementById('homepage_location_container').innerHTML = locationString;
						$('#homepage_location_box').toggle('fast');
						$.get("/newtcore/candidates/ajax_getstate.cfm",{statename: state},
				      	function(stateinfo){
				      		$.get("/newtcore/candidates/ajax_setstatesession.cfm",{stateid:stateinfo});
				      		setJobs(stateinfo);
				      	}
				      );
					}
				}
			);
		}
		else{
			alert('Zip/Postal code must be 5-7 numbers/characters long.');
		}
	}
	function setJobs(state){
		$.getJSON('/newtcore/candidates/ajax_getjobs.cfm',
		{
	      maxResults: 10
	      , states: state
	      , getDescription: true
	      , excludejobcategory: '1191,1198,1196,1512,1436'
	      , companylimit: 3
	      , SubscriberTypeID: 1
	   },
	   function(jobInfo){
	      /*jobInfo.DATA
	      0: jobid - job id in database
	      1: jobTitle
	      2: subscriberID
	      3: updated
	      4: stateName
	      5: joblocation
	      6: nationwide
	      7: Canadanationwide
	      8: companyName
	      9: States
	      10: jobURL
	      11: companyURL
	      12: description*/

	      var temp = "";
	      var excludeCompanyList = "-1";
	      //Number of notes to display
	      var numberOfJobs = jobInfo.DATA.length;
	      //Display all jobs
	      for(var i = 0; i < numberOfJobs; i++){
	         temp = temp + '<div class="displayjobs_job_info_div">';
	         temp = temp + '<div class="displayjobs_job_title_div"><a href="' + jobInfo.DATA[i][10] + '">' + jobInfo.DATA[i][1] + '</a></div>';
	         temp = temp + '<div class="displayjobs_job_company_div">' + jobInfo.DATA[i][8] + ' - ' + jobInfo.DATA[i][5];
	         if(jobInfo.DATA[i][5] != ''){
	         	temp = temp + ', ';
	         }
	         if(jobInfo.DATA[i][6] == 1){
	         	temp = temp + 'Telecommute/Work Remotely</div>';
	         }
	         else if(jobInfo.DATA[i][7] == 1){
	         	temp = temp + 'Telecommute/Work Remotely</div>'
	         }
	         else{
	         	if(jobInfo.DATA[i][9] != ''){
	         		if(jobInfo.DATA[i][9].split(',').length > 4){
							temp = temp + 'Multiple Locations</div>';
	         		}
	         		else{
	         			temp = temp + jobInfo.DATA[i][9] + '</div>';
	         		}
		         }
		         else{
		         	temp = temp + jobInfo.DATA[i][4] + '</div>';
		         }
	         }
	         var description = jobInfo.DATA[i][12].replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'');
	         var descriptionEnd = 0;
	         if(description.indexOf(' ',100) == -1){
	         	descriptionEnd = 100;
	         }
	         else{
	         	descriptionEnd = description.indexOf(' ',100);
	         }
	         temp = temp + '<div class="displayjobs_job_description_div">' + description.substring(0,descriptionEnd);
	         if(description.length > descriptionEnd){
	         	temp = temp + '...';
	         }
	         temp = temp + '</div><div class="displayjobs_job_options_div">';
	         var currentdate = new Date();
	         var updateddate = new Date(jobInfo.DATA[i][3]);
	         var dateDifference = Math.floor((currentdate-updateddate)/(3600000*24));
	         temp = temp + 'Updated ';
	         if(dateDifference == 0){
	         	temp = temp + ' today<br>';
	         }
	         else{
	         	temp = temp + dateDifference + ' days ago<br>';
	         }
	         if(jobInfo.DATA[i][8] != 'Confidential'){
					temp = temp + '<a href="' + jobInfo.DATA[i][11] + '">Company Jobs</a> - ';
	         }
	         temp = temp + '<a href="/index.cfm/fuseaction/emailthisjob/jobid/' + jobInfo.DATA[i][0] + '.htm" target="_blank">Send to Friend</a> - <a href="/index.cfm/fuseaction/jobsearchresults/jobid/' + jobInfo.DATA[i][0] + '/overridejt/y.htm">Similar Jobs</a></div>';
	         temp = temp + '</div>';
	         excludeCompanyList = excludeCompanyList + ',' + jobInfo.DATA[i][2];
	      }
	      if(numberOfJobs < 10){
	      	$.getJSON('/newtcore/candidates/ajax_getjobs.cfm',
				{
			      maxResults: 10 - numberOfJobs
			      , excludesid: excludeCompanyList
			      , getDescription: true
			      , excludejobcategory: '1191,1198,1196,1512,1436'
			      , companylimit: 3
			      , SubscriberTypeID: 1
			   },
			   function(jobInfo){
			      //Number of notes to display
			      var numberOfJobs = jobInfo.DATA.length;
			      //Display all jobs
			      for(var i = 0; i < numberOfJobs; i++){
			      	
			         temp = temp + '<div class="displayjobs_job_info_div">';
			         temp = temp + '<div class="displayjobs_job_title_div"><a href="' + jobInfo.DATA[i][10] + '">' + jobInfo.DATA[i][1] + '</a></div>';
			         temp = temp + '<div class="displayjobs_job_company_div">' + jobInfo.DATA[i][8] + ' - ' + jobInfo.DATA[i][5];
			         if(jobInfo.DATA[i][5] != ''){
			         	temp = temp + ', ';
			         }
			         if(jobInfo.DATA[i][6] == 1){
			         	temp = temp + 'Telecommute/Work Remotely</div>';
			         }
			         else if(jobInfo.DATA[i][7] == 1){
			         	temp = temp + 'Telecommute/Work Remotely</div>'
			         }
			         else{
			         	if(jobInfo.DATA[i][9] != ''){
			         		if(jobInfo.DATA[i][9].split(',').length > 4){
									temp = temp + 'Multiple Locations</div>';
			         		}
			         		else{
			         			temp = temp + jobInfo.DATA[i][9] + '</div>';
			         		}
				         }
				         else{
				         	temp = temp + jobInfo.DATA[i][4] + '</div>';
				         }
			         }
			         var description = jobInfo.DATA[i][12].replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'');
			         var descriptionEnd = 0;
			         if(description.indexOf(' ',100) == -1){
			         	descriptionEnd = 100;
			         }
			         else{
			         	descriptionEnd = description.indexOf(' ',100);
			         }
			         temp = temp + '<div class="displayjobs_job_description_div">' + description.substring(0,descriptionEnd);
			         if(description.length > descriptionEnd){
			         	temp = temp + '...';
			         }
			         temp = temp + '</div><div class="displayjobs_job_options_div">';
			         var currentdate = new Date();
			         var updateddate = new Date(jobInfo.DATA[i][3]);
			         var dateDifference = Math.floor((currentdate-updateddate)/(3600000*24));
			         temp = temp + 'Updated ';
			         if(dateDifference == 0){
			         	temp = temp + ' today<br>';
			         }
			         else{
			         	temp = temp + dateDifference + ' days ago<br>';
			         }
			         if(jobInfo.DATA[i][8] != 'Confidential'){
							temp = temp + '<a href="' + jobInfo.DATA[i][11] + '">Company Jobs</a> - ';
			         }
			         temp = temp + '<a href="/index.cfm/fuseaction/emailthisjob/jobid/' + jobInfo.DATA[i][0] + '.htm" target="_blank">Send to Friend</a> - <a href="/index.cfm/fuseaction/jobsearchresults/jobid/' + jobInfo.DATA[i][0] + '/overridejt/y.htm">Similar Jobs</a></div>';
			         temp = temp + '</div>';
			      }
			      $('#jobDiv').html(temp);
			   });
	      }
	      else{
	      	$('#jobDiv').html(temp);
	      }
	   });
	}

	
	var $state = $("select#searchState").smartselect({
                    multiple: false,
                    text: {
                           selectLabel: 'Select a state/province'
                    },
                    toolbar: false
                }).getsmartselect();

	$state.addCallback('onOptionSelected', function($target, event) {
        document.getElementById('stateDisplay').innerHTML = $target.text();
    });
</script>
